title: Haze4K conditional continuous-utility measurement qualification
rationale: The archived taper and content-aligned routes precisely rejected hard-action regret targets but did not directly test whether their underlying continuous utility contrasts are stable. This orthogonal Stage-1 route changes only measurement_target. Before the full 100-scene qualification is materialized, the first operation runs a fixed 32-scene variance-only precision supplement. It withholds the primary mean and uses the conservative maximum of a one-sided chi-square and scene-bootstrap SD upper bound. Only a bound supporting the frozen 0.025 dB precision distance at n=100 authorizes the full operation; otherwise the route stops as BLOCKED_PRECISION. Model, checkpoint, actions, metric, taper carrier, grouping, data role, and protected-data prohibitions remain frozen.

orthogonal_changes.reason: Replace the discontinuous hard-action regret target with two keep-referenced continuous PSNR utility contrasts while preserving the verified taper spatial carrier and every other scientific factor.

scientific_contract.question: Can a fixed variance-only pilot certify that 100 canonical Haze4K development scenes can estimate the frozen continuous-utility error within a 0.025 dB one-sided precision distance, without examining or publishing the primary mean?

intervention.primary_variable: dispersion of scene-level worst-held-out-phase area-weighted L-infinity error between source-taper-projected and held-out two-dimensional keep-referenced PSNR utility contrasts
intervention.reference: maximum planning SD 0.12755336423116348 dB implied by a 0.025 dB normal-mean half-width at 100 independent scenes
intervention.matched_budget: 32 canonical scenes selected by a frozen salted SHA-256 order, four nested haze variants per scene, one official inference per variant, and no result-adaptive extension
fixed_factors: the full 100-scene development asset is validated before a fixed first-32 salted-SHA-256 subset is selected
the subset selection uses public salt haze4k-continuous-utility-precision-pilot-v1 and never inspects images or outcomes
actions remain clip(hazy + scale times (official_prediction minus hazy), 0, 1) at scales keep 1.0, weaken 0.8, and strengthen 1.2
for each tile and non-keep action the continuous utility is 10 log10(MSE_keep divided by MSE_action); keep is exactly zero
grid origins remain exactly (0,0), (0,16), (16,0), and (16,16) with 32-pixel tiles and the verified strictly-positive normalized raised-cosine taper
each phase is held out once; only the other three source phases contribute to its projected utility

within a held-out phase the two-action absolute contrast error uses L-infinity, tiles are weighted by pixel area, four haze variants are equally averaged, and the worst of four phases is the scene value
only scene-value dispersion, its chi-square SD bound, its bootstrap SD bound, and feasibility are published; the primary mean is withheld
the conservative planning SD is the maximum of the one-sided 95 percent chi-square and nonparametric 20000-resample scene-bootstrap SD upper bounds
future feasibility requires conservative planning SD no greater than 0.12755336423116348 dB and required n no greater than 100
the future target gate remains 0.05 dB because an L-infinity contrast error epsilon gives an approximate 2 epsilon plug-in action-regret bound against the existing 0.10 dB limit
haze variants, actions, phases, tiles, pixels and bootstrap resamples never increase independent n
candidate confirmation, NH-HAZE, canary, locked test, training, fitting, threshold tuning and metric-family changes are prohibited

primary_estimand.metric: maximum of a one-sided 95 percent chi-square SD upper bound and a 20000-resample scene-bootstrap 95th-percentile SD upper bound, in dB
primary_estimand.aggregation: compute one frozen worst-phase continuous-utility error for each of 32 independent canonical scenes; never publish their mean; estimate dispersion and compare its conservative upper bound with the n=100 planning limit

controls: direct parent terminal and verified taper production-path identities must match exactly
all 400 development pairs and 100 canonical-scene groups must be complete before pilot selection
the fixed salted-hash selection must contain exactly 32 scenes and 128 nested variants
keep output is structurally identical to the official prediction and non-keep actions obey the affine manipulation on every non-clipped pixel

an independent small reference case verifies dB direction, keep zero, held-out exclusion, taper projection, area weighting, L-infinity action aggregation, variant averaging, worst-phase aggregation, and terminal mapping
the primary mean is absent from compact evidence and terminal logic
no protected asset is delivered and no model or proxy is trained

uncertainty.method: one-sided 95 percent chi-square SD bound with 31 degrees of freedom plus a 20000-resample canonical-scene bootstrap SD upper bound at fixed seed 20260811; use the larger bound

gates.estimand: exact evidence identities, complete 100-scene source population, fixed 32-scene subset, 128 finite official inferences, reference checks, no protected access, no training, and primary mean withheld
conservative one-sided 95 percent planning SD upper bound in dB

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: A precision PASS proves only that the frozen 100-scene experiment is capable of resolving the 0.05 dB utility-error margin at the required precision; it says nothing about whether the mean utility error will pass. A precision FAIL is BLOCKED_PRECISION, not evidence that continuous utility itself is unstable. Approximate-normal chi-square calibration is guarded by the larger nonparametric bootstrap SD bound but remains development-screening planning evidence.
disabled_actions: publishing, interpreting, or gating on the pilot primary mean
using pilot scenes as independent confirmation or adding them to the future n=100
changing the 0.05 dB target-error margin, 0.025 dB precision distance, subset size, selection salt, SD bound, actions, metric, taper, grids, data, or terminal mapping after launch
materializing or launching the full operation unless this exact typed terminal authorizes FULL_CONTINUOUS_UTILITY_MEASUREMENT_ONLY
accessing confirmation, NH-HAZE, canary, locked-test or other protected evidence
training a model or proxy, choosing a representation, changing metric family, tuning taper or grid definitions, or entering Stage 2

precision_contract.rationale: This operation is the formal variance supplement for the new estimand. A conservative maximum allowable planning SD of 0.1275533642 dB requires 25 groups for a 0.05 dB descriptive half-width, so the fixed 32-scene pilot has adequate capacity without counting nested repeats. Its result, not this capacity calculation, decides future n=100 feasibility at 0.025 dB.

capability.production_path_statement: The strict-loaded frozen official Haze4K ConvIR-B executes on a 1200 by 1600 protected-data-free CUDA fixture, then the exact production action replay, four taper phases, keep-referenced dB contrasts, held-out exclusion, area-weighted L-infinity aggregation, variance bounds, feasibility gate and typed finalizer execute through the imported SHA-bound verified taper path plus the new entrypoint.

precision.estimand: descriptive capacity for the 32-scene continuous-utility variance supplement
precision.source_reference: The planning SD is the algebraic maximum compatible with a 0.025 dB normal-mean half-width at the frozen future n=100; it is a result-independent design bound, not an observed utility result.
